title: Polynomial-time last-visit coding
statement: The function that sends a Boolean word to the code of the index immediately before its last true entry, with the empty word returned when there is no true entry, is computable in polynomial time.
replaced: The function taking an ordered flag word to the code of its last marked index is polynomial-time computable: the flag word is threaded through the last-true stripper, an absent result maps to the empty code, and otherwise the stripped prefix's binary length is exactly the index of the last marked row.
